subject: exp-info-b
title: EXP.INFO.P.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 37 (WM-13). EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of" (the title writes EXP.INFO.P.); MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and INFO-TRNS (information transference). From AF-DY: DYM-SPI. From DYM-SPI: HI-P (high purpose) and TRS (transition). From HI-P: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From TRS: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics).
